chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurara, who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'There is neither an Azan nor an Iqamah on the day of Al-Fitr and Al-Adha; their Azan is the rising of the sun. When it rises, they go out. And there is no Salat before them nor after them. And whoever does not pray Salat with an Imam in a Jam'ah, then there is no Salat for him, nor is there Qada' upon him.'
ai.seo_question: What are the rulings on Azan, Iqamah, and congregation for Eid Al-Fitr and Eid Al-Adha prayers?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the procedural distinctiveness of Eid prayers by replacing the formal Azan and Iqamah with the natural signal of sunrise, reflecting the simplicity and communal nature of these festivals. It further emphasizes the juridical weight of congregational prayer (Jama'ah) by asserting that praying individually voids the obligation without requiring a make-up, a ruling that highlights the communal dimension of worship in Shia fiqh. This hadith is central to understanding the ritual structure of Eid in al-Kafi, distinguishing it from daily prayers and underscoring the Imam's role in unifying the community.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Bin Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Zurara who said,

‘Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘In a day of (Eid) Al-Fitr and (Eid) Al-Azha, there is neither an Azan nor an Iqamah. An Azaan of these two is the emergence of the sun. When it emerges, they should be going out, and there is neither a Salāt before these two or after them; and the one who does not pray Salāt with a prayer leader in a Jam’at, so there is no Salāt for him, nor is there a fulfilment (of an outsanding one) upon him’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ’Udhaynah from Zurarah who has said the following: “

Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘There Adhan or ‘Iqamah is not for the day of al-Fitr and al- Adha’. Adhan for it is sunrise. When it is sunrise, they go out. There is not any Salah (prayer) before or after it. If one does not perform Salah (prayer) with an Imam in congregation, there is not any Salah (prayer) for him and performing Qada’ (compensatory prayer) also is not necessary for him.”
